title: Prior Authorization Reference for Charge Reviews on the Insulin Pump Program
content:
When a non-covered item charge on an Insulin Pump Program is reviewed, the covered rate of the reviewed line follows the grant the line drew on, in three cases:

1. Where that grant is a payer prior authorization, the standard covered rate is replaced with its units authorized times 30 divided by the days its span covers with both ends included, rounded down.
2. Where that grant rests on the written order itself and an over-limit justification record dated in the 12 months before today is on file, it is replaced with the written order's quantity per 30 days.
3. Otherwise the standard covered rate stands.

The span of a prior authorization runs from its valid-from date to its valid-through date, both counted. An over-limit justification record is a clinical document on the program recorded for the purpose of over-limit justification, dated by its visit date. A record counts as in a number of months before today when its date is later than the same day of the month that many months before today, so a record dated exactly that many months before today is outside the window.

| Hypothetical grant | Covered rate per 30 days |
|---|---|
| Prior authorization, 120 units over a span of 180 days | replaced with 3,600 divided by 180, which is 20 |
| Prior authorization, 100 units over a span of 181 days | replaced with 3,000 divided by 181, 16.57, rounded down to 16 |
| Written-order grant, order of 12 per 30 days, over-limit justification dated 2 months before today | replaced with 12 |
| Written-order grant, no over-limit justification in the last 12 months | the standard covered rate stands |
